artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the white bread loaves appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine crumb detail and irregular crust structure expected of real baked bread. The flour dusting looks like a uniform spray rather than natural settling.
The layers of the chocolate cake appear to merge and melt into each other without distinct separation. The edges are soft and undefined, suggesting a failure in rendering rigid, layered structures.

The horizontal lines of the shelves and the top of the display case show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective, particularly on the right side where the metal frame seems to bend unnaturally.
There is an inconsistent depth of field; some background elements are sharply blurred while others at similar distances retain some definition, typical of AI-generated depth mapping errors.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the bread loaves. Real bread usually has a more matte, irregular crust. The chocolate cake's layers should be distinct; if they are melting together, it is a significant structural artifact. Check if the flour dusting follows gravity and surface contours naturally.
